title: Final Energy Equation
description: Essential Criteria: The student must provide the correct expression for the minimum energy of the moving proton in the first scenario.

title: Second Energy Equation
description: Essential Criteria: The student must provide the correct expression for the energy when the protons move towards each other with equal velocity.

title: Invariant Mass Concept
description: Important Criteria: The student should demonstrate understanding of the invariant mass and its application in the collision process.

title: Energy-Momentum Relation
description: Important Criteria: The student must correctly apply the energy-momentum relation to derive the energy of the moving proton.

title: Sign Errors
description: Pitfall Criteria: The student must avoid common sign mistakes in the energy and momentum equations.
